name: Cold: Non-Linear
source:
In Cold:Non-Linear, you play as a young black bear, named Jordan, who's recently graduated high school. With his friends slowly drifting apart , Jordan will need to answer an  important question: what will he do with his life? Whether he pursues his passions, or otherwise, the choice is yours.

[From [url=https://grizzystudios.itch.io/cold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Cold: Non-Linear》中，你将扮演乔丹，一只刚刚高中毕业的年轻黑熊。朋友们逐渐各奔东西，乔丹必须回答一个重要的问题：今后的人生，该如何度过？是追寻热爱，还是另走他路，选择权在你手中。

[摘自[url=https://grizzystudios.itch.io/cold]itch.io[/url]]
